title: Behind the Screen: Investigating ChatGPT’s Dark Personality Traits and Conspiracy Beliefs

bias_targets.methodology: Administering psychological questionnaires (the Dark Factor Test and the Mach-IV scale) via API to compute average scores on dark personality traits and Machiavellianism, and testing the impact of assigned personas (e.g., antagonistic, trustworthy).

Administering the Generic Conspiracist Beliefs Scale (GCBS) and the Conspiracy Mentality Scale (CMS) via API to measure the model's baseline susceptibility to conspiracy theories and rational skepticism.
Assigning extreme political system roles (far-left and far-right personas) to the model and evaluating how these affiliations alter its conspiracy ideation scores.
